page.overview:
What is Sheb-Teth?

Sheb-Teth is an eyeless alien humanoid entity, massively overgrown with both flesh and machinery. It appears in Once Men, a fan created sourcebook for the Call of Cthulhu roleplaying game published under their Miskatonic University Library Association Monograph line, a third party licensing program run by Chaosium.
